description.value: Unique Bakery is a Richmond artisan bakery specializing in handcrafted, naturally fermented breads, bagels, pretzels, and toast made from locally sourced ingredients. The shop emphasizes traditional slow-fermentation techniques and low-sugar, low-fat recipes, producing fresh loaves daily from scratch. Online ordering with in-store pickup is available, and the bread is also stocked at several nearby Richmond and Burnaby retail partners.
